description: This file contains the implementation of the AlertService interface in the OpenMRS project. It provides methods to create, retrieve, delete, and notify alerts, primarily for user notifications within the system. The class is annotated with @Transactional, indicating its involvement in transactional operations tied to database interactions.

classes.name: AlertServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AlertService interface for managing in-system alerts, including creation, retrieval, and notification functionalities within OpenMRS.

methods.name: setAlertDAO
methods.description: Setter method to inject the AlertDAO dependency used for database operations related to alerts.

methods.name: saveAlert
methods.description: Saves a new alert or updates an existing one, setting creator and timestamps if not already set, and ensuring recipients are correctly associated.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Retrieves an alert by its identifier.

methods.name: purgeAlert
methods.description: Deletes the specified alert from the system.

methods.name: getAllActiveAlerts
methods.description: Fetches all active alerts for a specified user.

methods.name: getAlertsByUser
methods.description: Retrieves unread alerts for a user, defaulting to the authenticated user if none specified.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Fetches alerts for a user with options to include read or expired alerts.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Retrieves all alerts regardless of user.

methods.name: getAllAlerts
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve alerts with an option to include expired alerts.

methods.name: notifySuperUsers
methods.description: Creates and sends an alert message to all users with the superuser role, including optional stack trace information if an exception is provided.
